# 原子振幅怎样变成一条谱线？: # How do atomic amplitudes become a spectral line?
在“非弹性散射与动态结构因子”的双原子链和相干相位两节课中打开可选回放。课程提供: Open the optional replay in the diatomic-chain and coherent-phase lessons under Inelastic scattering and dynamic structure factors. Classroom examples are explicitly marked as references; copying an example still requires manual calculation. The calculator can include the atomic-amplitude derivation in the same calculation. Opening a returned replay does not solve the phonons again.
## 先固定动量与坐标约定: ## Fix the momentum and coordinate convention first
输入的 Q 是完整散射坐标，链轴投影为 Q∥=Q cosθ。声子使用的约化波矢: The input Q is the full scattering coordinate, with chain-axis projection Q∥=Q cosθ. The phonon wavevector q is folded into [−π/a,π/a), with Q∥=q+nG and G=2π/a. Changing reciprocal zone n can preserve q and phonon energies while changing atomic phases and intensity. Changing the angle can also change q, so it cannot be interpreted solely as an intensity projection.
本模型采用原胞周期本征矢：u_lκ 正比于 eκ(q) exp(iqla)/√m: This model uses cell-periodic eigenvectors: u_lκ is proportional to eκ(q) exp(iqla)/√mκ. The atom order is A, B, at equilibrium positions 0, sa, and each eigenvector satisfies Σκ|eκ|²=1. The coefficients e are mass normalized; e/√m gives relative physical displacement. No absolute displacement amplitude, displacement unit or thermal snapshot is assigned.
## 逐因子构造复振幅: ## Build the complex amplitude factor by factor
创建分支 ν 的声子时，每个原子的贡献为 aκ=Q∥ bκ exp(iQ∥τκ): For creation of a phonon in branch ν, atom κ contributes aκ=Q∥ bκ exp(iQ∥τκ) eκν(q)*/√mκ. The replay lists the eigenvector, mass divisor, complex conjugation, structural phase and signed scattering weight separately. Its complex-plane arrows depict these returned complex numbers, not real-space atomic trajectories.
相干散射先相加振幅：Aν=aA+aB，随后取 |Aν|²。直接相加 |aA|²+: Coherent scattering adds amplitudes first, Aν=aA+aB, and then takes |Aν|². Adding |aA|²+|aB|² directly discards the interference term 2 Re(aA aB*). A negative interference term can cancel positive individual contributions. A dark branch does not mean that its phonon has disappeared.
在等质量、等弹簧、s=1/2 且 bA=bB 的折叠链中，参考偶区和奇区会交换明: In the folded chain with equal masses and springs, s=1/2 and bA=bB, the even- and odd-zone references exchange bright and dark branches. Their full Q values differ, as does the longitudinal prefactor Q∥². Compare |A|²/Q∥² or the complete factor ledger to isolate phase selection. This ratio is left undefined at Q∥=0; no division by zero is performed.
## 从振幅到非弹性谱权重: ## From amplitude to inelastic spectral weight
对保留的能量 εν，裸权重为 Wν=C|Aν|²/εν，C=ℏ²/(2 amu): For a retained energy εν, the bare weight is Wν=C|Aν|²/εν, with C=ℏ²/(2 amu) converted using this tool’s Å and meV convention. Stokes creation multiplies by nν+1, while anti-Stokes annihilation multiplies by nν. Gaussian broadening distributes these integrated weights over the energy axis. Its width is not a calculated phonon lifetime.
Γ 点声学模可以有明确的相对位移和原子振幅，但其能量为零。回放保留这部分账本，并: A Gamma acoustic mode can have well-defined relative displacements and atomic amplitudes while having zero energy. The replay retains that ledger and preserves the original low-energy cutoff: excluded modes are not divided by εν, are not assigned a Bose occupation, and do not generate inelastic peaks. The cutoff is not a material gap and does not constitute an elastic-scattering calculation.
## 整体相位、相对相位与简并: ## Common phase, relative phase and degeneracy
将同一模的全部本征矢系数乘 exp(iφ)，会把散射振幅乘 exp(−iφ)，而: Multiplying every eigenvector coefficient of one mode by exp(iφ) multiplies its scattering amplitude by exp(−iφ), leaving |A|² unchanged. Changing only one atom’s phase usually changes relative displacement, but can be equivalent to a common phase if the eigenvector occupies only one atom. The replay reports the normalized-state overlap magnitude squared and the eigen-equation residual, separately checking common-phase equivalence and whether the vector remains an eigenmode of the original matrix. It does not interpret this counterexample as a new spectrum. A change of atomic-coordinate phase convention likewise requires transforming both eigenvectors and scattering phases.
整体相位等价的数值判断采用 |1−|⟨e|e′⟩|²|≤10⁻¹²。满足它表示在: The numerical common-phase test uses |1−|⟨e|e′⟩|²|≤10⁻¹². Passing it means that the states are close to the same ray within this tolerance; it does not prove that a component is exactly zero or that the states are mathematically identical.
在两支严格简并处，任选本征矢可以酉混合。逐分支振幅与强度依赖所选基底，应比较完整: At exact two-branch degeneracy, the chosen eigenvectors may be mixed unitarily. Individual branch amplitudes and strengths depend on that basis; compare Σν|Aν|² over the complete degenerate subspace. The original spectrum groups energies within 10⁻⁸ meV. The replay also reports the group energy spread and shows mixing only when that spread is at most 64 machine eps times max(1, maximum energy), with the mixed eigen-equation residual. Numerical grouping alone does not prove exact degeneracy. Nondegenerate branches cannot be arbitrarily mixed and still be called eigenmodes of the original dynamical matrix.
输入 includeAmplitudeReplay=true 在 data.am: The input includeAmplitudeReplay=true adds the derivation for the selected full Q under data.amplitudeReplay. Omitting it or setting it to false preserves the original result. It does not duplicate the replay for every heatmap point, and opening the panel does not change the calculation. Original inputs, spectra, exports and records remain associated with their own calculation.
这里仍是理想一维纵向谐链，b 是有符号相对常数。它没有导入真实材料的完整 Pho: This remains an ideal one-dimensional longitudinal harmonic chain, with signed relative constants b. It does not import complete Phonopy scattering data for a real material, and it does not add Debye–Waller factors, magnetic scattering, multiphonon processes or fitted cross sections. The existing ZnO import example inspects supplied phonon data; it does not automatically supply scattering input to this model.
